dct_description_sm: To better understand radiative forcing in the Beaufort Sea region by recording thermal properties of clouds using Forward Looking Infrared Imagery (FLIR).  This data complements the radiation dataset (CCIN - 11622).  The purpose of this data is to better understand radiation budgets, radiative forcing of sea ice, and radiative heating of the ocean surface layer.
dct_title_s: Cloud Thermal Properties Joint Ocean Ice Study (JOIS) 2012 (University of Manitoba)
